decisions.reason: The software platform is a multi-model product line that the firm publicly presents as the flagship of its strategic direction, so dropping it would write off heavy investment and discredit an announced course.
The mobile field data capture software is close to the core offer, had its own page in both years, and fits the platform ecosystem, so the sunk investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
The search extension was actively updated to version 1.6.0, showing continued investment and public commitment within the core web-map ecosystem, unlike the small plugins that were already dropped.
